svg.text: CampusNest — Logical ERD (Crow's Foot) · Part B
Accounts, profiles, trust, roommates and reference data · all columns, PK / FK / UK marked
target_type + target_id point to one LISTING, REVIEW or
USER (no FK possible; checked by the application)
PK primary key · FK foreign key
UK part of a unique constraint
• A profile shares its user's key
• A request cannot be sent to
